repos.name: website
repos.deploy: Public marketing site (buildmy.house), Astro static output. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs lint, check, build only: there is NO deploy job. docs/DEPLOY.md describes a wrangler Cloudflare Workers upload plus a manual promote step, and DEPLOYMENT.md says server output with @astrojs/cloudflare; neither matches CI or astro.config.mjs (static). How the live site actually updates is unverified: a merge to main is the human decision, check with Nahar before assuming it goes live.
repos.notes: src/ pages and components. The /diary sitemap paths are a hand-kept diaryPaths list in astro.config.mjs: when a diary blog post merges, a separate website PR must add its path.

repos.name: hermees-diary
repos.deploy: Hermes diary (served under buildmy.house/diary), Astro static output; this is where the blog lives (src/content/blog/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md). CI runs lint, check, build only. DEPLOYMENT.md claims auto-deploy to Cloudflare Workers via GitHub Actions on push, but no deploy job exists in the repo; the Dockerfile only runs the dev server. Live deploy path unverified.
repos.notes: Blog posts use the front matter in src/content/config.ts. Use `marketing-lead blog pr` for posts (it validates and analyses them); use `marketing-lead repo` for other edits.

repos.name: observer-website
repos.deploy: Observer site, Astro server output with @astrojs/node, reads observer.* tables from Postgres as the read-only hermes_analytics role. CI runs lint, check, build only. DEPLOYMENT.md describes a self-hosted Node/Docker run; no deploy job and no manifest for it in company-os. Live deploy path unverified.
repos.notes: Server-rendered with a database read path: do not add write queries or any credentials to the repo. Append-only data model is documented in the UI.
